conclusions: SoftVT learned forecasts improve coordinate motion versus persistence/velocity, but shape error remains worse than near-rigid persistence. Compare nearest retrieval before attributing benefit to neural inference.
Sloth pushing remains unsupported: compare against velocity, not only persistence.
SoftVT top8 retrieval has one frozen member failure at frame110; both ensemble channels retain all48 suffix frames as failures. No member replacement or exclusion.
No retrieval posterior coverage: top8 diversity is descriptive, not calibrated uncertainty. All cases historically exposed development.

summary.scope: Two historically exposed development cases; fixed derived v02 policy, no selection or retraining
summary.decision: Do not promote globally: push-sloth coordinate errors improve versus raw but remain worse than velocity and retain shape failure; SoftVT worsens and free-flight penetrates the floor. Preserve frozen policy and negative results.
summary.uncertainty: Pose point estimates remove pose-sample variation; intervals reflect transformed FEM shape samples only and exclude failed inherited samples. Not calibrated joint uncertainty.
